Beginning of Wave 23 ([[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Slow Boss''', previously known as '''Boss2''', is a slow and tough boss that appears in the [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] and Basic Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appeared in the [[SFOTH Event]], [[The Classic Event]] and [[The Takeover Event]]. Though the '''Slow Boss''' is slower than the [[Normal Boss]] and [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]], its high health makes it a considerable threat. Later on in the game, it will appear in large, mostly packed, hordes, causing many problems if you lack high DPS towers. The '''Slow Boss''' can be spawned by the [[Mystery Boss]] upon its death in the [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] and [[Easy Mode|Easy]] modes. In [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode, the [[Grave Digger]] used to rarely spawn the '''Slow Boss'''. The '''Slow Boss''' could also have been spawned by the [[Swordmaster]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Slow Boss''' is a large humanoid with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It has a desaturated dark green skin color and a light brown torso, waist and legs. It is faceless and is lightly covered in dirt. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Slow Boss''' was a humanoid with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It had a dark green skin color, and a light brown torso, waist and legs, which were all coated in dirt. It was faceless. }} |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the legacy '''Slow Boss''' has a desaturated green skin color and a diagonal scar going across its face. It has a grey pebble torso and legs. It has green hooks on its torso and right arm and has large tumors on its left arm. Its torso occasionally emits green particles. Its head is slightly tilted downwards and it has a twisted left leg. It makes a dry roaring sound on death. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The current [[Enemies Beta]] version of the legacy '''Slow Boss''' is a humanoid with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It has a dark green skin color, and a light brown torso, waist and legs, which are all coated in dirt. It is faceless. It makes a dry roaring sound on death. |Version 2 |The second version of the legacy '''Slow Boss''' is similar to the current version, except it had glowing red eyes with a mouth closed by teal stitches. |Version 1 |The first version version of the legacy '''Slow Boss''' had a dark green skin color and a dark grey corroded torso and dark brown corroded legs. It had a drooling zombie face with glowing red eyes. It also emitted green particles from its torso. }} }} ==Strategy== *Many towers can be used to deal with the '''Slow Boss''' on its debut. **High-DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] and [[Turret]] are able to defeat the '''Slow Boss''' rather quickly. **Stronger early game towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Militant]], [[Soldier]], [[Brawler]], [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Cowboy]], when upgraded to higher levels are strong options against the '''Slow Boss'''. *Multiple towers can take advantage of the '''Slow Boss'''' slow speed. **Short-ranged towers like the [[Assassin]] are able to get many more hits in, making them more effective. **The [[Military Base]] and [[Crook Boss]]' [[units]] will have more time to shoot at the '''Slow Boss''' before colliding into it. **The [[Brawler]] on Levels 2 and above is able to stunlock multiple '''Slow Bosses'''. *Though not necessary, all stalling towers will work against the '''Slow Boss''', and can slow it down significantly. **However, the first '''Slow Boss''' in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode is a [[Boss]] enemy. This means it is either fully or partially unaffected by all forms of stalling. **Do note that the '''Slow Boss''' large size makes the freezing, knockback and stunning towers like [[Freezer]], [[Brawler]] and [[Warden]] less effective than usual. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants (Modern)}} EasySlowBoss.png|First version (24 February 2024 – 25 September 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants (Legacy)}} NewSlowBoss.png|Second version, second animation (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) SlowBoss.png|Second version, first animation (15 July 2019 – 29 October 2020) Boss2-0.png|First version (14 June 2019 – 15 July 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Modern)}} SlowBossWalk.gif|Current version, current walk animation (25 September 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Legacy)}} LegacySlowBossWalk.gif|Current version, current walk animation (8 May 2021 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants (Modern)}} DefHacker1SlowBoss.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2SlowBoss.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Modern)}} CorpseSlowBoss.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Legacy)}} CorpseLegacySlowBoss.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} 1b23bd2ad145b214e9f6ce76d6f08a88.jpg|'''Slow Boss''' on the game thumbnail. LegacySlowBossIconIG.png|Legacy '''Slow Boss''' on the [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The original name and appearance were based on the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Boss2|Boss2]] from ''Tower Battles''. *When the [[Uber Mystery]] was in the game, it had a chance of spawning the '''Slow Boss''' upon its death in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] modes. *In [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], the '''Slow Boss''' had 10 defense. **This would be later re-added for the modern version with 25% defense. Although the legacy version has none. *The death sound '''Slow Boss''' makes is a deeper sound than [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Boss2|Boss2]]'s from ''Tower Battles''. *The [[Slow King]] and the [[Mega Slow]] can be considered 2 [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] variants of the '''Slow Boss'''. *Due to a bug, the '''Slow Bosses''' spawning on wave 29 of [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode were separated by an extremely long amount of time. Because of this, even without skipping the wave, the enemies would not have enough time to spawn, causing them to spawn on Wave 30 instead. **Since these enemies would not count as enemies that spawned on Wave 30, you could have them spawn after triumphing by killing just the enemies that spawned on wave 30. You could reach zero base health after triumphing this way, but this would not make you lose. **This was later fixed on 12th of March 2022, where the time between each spawn is now quicker, with each spawn being 2 seconds instead of 8 seconds. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''14 June 2019''' -
